text.text_excerpt: I enjoyed my meal from here. Yes I Truley did!!!!! I ordered a fish plate that came with salad, fries and I fried catfish. I ordered an additional fried fish and also two orders og baked macaroni. Oh and also about 4 slices of pound cake to add to my bill. It was about 20 bucks in total. It was really good. I am so satisfied. Although it was a bit pricey, however, It was money well spent so I can't complain. My fish was fried right. I enjoyed it. I loved the mac and cheese and last but not least the Lemon pound cake. I loved it yall!!!!!! NICE AND MOIST. SO GOOD!!!

I ordered the lemon pepper wings and ouwee wings. The lemon pepper wings were really good. Not too salty and the chicken wasn't over cooked. The wings are a nice size, so no complaints there. The ouwee wings taste like Sweet Baby Rays with spices. I ordered 5 of each type of wings and after the third wing, the ouwee wings were too sweet for my taste. The restaurant is pretty small and is located in a particularly abandoned strip mall. The parking lot is small but there's plenty of parking space. The food came quickly and you get a free cup of ranch!

This is quite literally my neighborhood joint. So I feel quite ashamed that this was my first visit. We did a walk in order of wings and the shrimp and fish plate. They were tasty, above acceptable but the real reason this is a four versus a three is that all the meats/seafood were fresh not frozen or atleast tasted that way. Really my only comment would be reconsider the fried brand they use as they were almost greasy. Prices were on par, place was clean, as we waited (it is fresh to order) they did start playing music loudly. Bur it was old school R&B so it is hard to be mad about that.
